about.heroDesc: Your journey toward recovery begins here… where pain turns into hope, and treatment becomes a fully integrated human experience that brings together science, precision, and care.
about.heroImageAlt: Rehabilitation session with therapist and patient
about.whoWeAreText: AL Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center is dedicated to providing exceptional rehabilitation care that goes beyond just treatment. Our focus is on restoring a patient's movement, confidence, and quality of life through personalized and evidence-based therapy. As a leading center in physical therapy and medical rehabilitation, we operate with the highest medical standards, using the latest global treatment protocols. We stand out as the founders of an international research network that spans over 100 centers in 19 countries, allowing us to continuously update our treatment plans based on the most current scientific advancements. We offer flexible treatment options tailored to each patient's needs, whether at our center or at home, with a dedicated transportation service to ensure continuous care. Our sessions are personalized and focused on individual treatment plans rather than fixed time durations, making the patient experience more effective and impactful. At AL Motahadi, we prioritize the human aspect of rehabilitation, placing the patient's comfort and needs at the core of every step of their therapeutic journey.
about.ourVisionText: To be a leading and reference center in the Sultanate of Oman and the region in the field of medical rehabilitation and physical therapy, by delivering therapeutic and research services of global quality and transforming the rehabilitation journey into a true story of life restoration.
about.ourMissionText: To provide comprehensive medical rehabilitation services based on advanced scientific treatment protocols, while respecting privacy, personalizing treatment for each patient, and strengthening mutual trust between the patient and the medical team.
about.humanFirstDesc: We place the patient at the center of every decision and step.
about.scientificExcellenceDesc: We innovate and lead through the latest global research-based protocols.
about.transparencyTrustDesc: We build our relationship with patients and the community on honesty and clarity.
about.professionalConfidentialityDesc: We adhere to the highest standards of patient data protection and privacy.
about.innovationDesc: We integrate science, experience, and technology to make a real difference.
about.responsibilityDesc: Serving the community is a core and firmly rooted part of our identity.
about.ourStoryHeading: AL Motahadi Center: From Idea to Opening
about.ourStoryText: The concept of AL Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center originated from a visionary goal to transform the rehabilitation sector in Oman by introducing a model that blends scientific excellence, human compassion, and community service. The center aimed to bring a fundamental change to the delivery of rehabilitation services, keeping pace with global advancements and focusing on the human aspect of therapy. The trial phase of the center began on September 1, 2024, with the training of medical and administrative teams, development of patient reception systems, and establishment of a culture of professional ethics. The official opening occurred on February 15, 2025, under the patronage of Her Highness Sayyida Hajija bint Jaifer Al Said, attended by dignitaries and health professionals. Since its opening, AL Motahadi has become a leading institution in medical rehabilitation in Oman, committed to maintaining high-quality standards and continuously evolving its treatment protocols through research and evaluation.
about.ourStoryImageAlt: AL Motahadi Center official opening ceremony — ribbon-cutting with dignitaries
about.founderDesc1: Behind the establishment of AL Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center stands Dr. Mohammed Reda bin Naji Al-Yazidi, a specialist in physical therapy and medical rehabilitation, and a pioneer in developing modern therapeutic models. He did not only establish the center, but also founded the international research network that is today considered one of the most prominent sources of advanced treatment protocols adopted by the center.
about.founderDesc2: His personal experience as a person with a disability shaped within him a deep human sensitivity and a unique understanding of patient needs; for him, care is not a service... but a human commitment.
about.founderDesc3: His journey combines clinical practice, scientific research, and academic influence, making AL Motahadi Center a landmark that embodies excellence in both knowledge and spirit.
about.founderImageAlt: Dr. Mohammed Reda bin Naji Al-Yazidi — Founder, AL Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center
about.medicalTeamDesc1: AL Motahadi Center includes an elite group of highly experienced specialists in physical therapy and rehabilitation, working according to the MDT (Multidisciplinary Team) model, which enables the development of a comprehensive and integrated treatment plan tailored to each case and regularly reviewed based on actual progress indicators.
about.medicalTeamDesc2: Our team's role is not limited to delivering treatment alone; they actively participate in scientific research conducted by the international research network, making them contributors to the creation of medical knowledge—not merely implementers of it.
about.medicalTeamDesc3: They are not just a therapeutic team... but partners in creating impact.
about.medicalTeamImageAlt: AL Motahadi medical team — healthcare professionals
about.socialResponsibilityText1: At AL Motahadi Center, we believe that our mission goes beyond treatment to include serving the community. Through the Ehata program, directed toward those most in need of rehabilitation services, we contribute to supporting low-income patients, the elderly, women and persons with disabilities through the Hope, Charity, Care, and Step packages.
about.socialResponsibilityText2: We also offer special discounts for retirees and employees of the Royal Oman Police, and organize educational workshops and awareness courses in partnership with government and private institutions to promote rehabilitation culture and quality of life.

Each member brings specialized expertise in physical therapy, medical rehabilitation, and holistic recovery approaches. Together, we work collaboratively to create individualized treatment plans that address the physical, functional, and quality-of-life needs of every patient.
team.heroSubdesc: Our multidisciplinary approach ensures comprehensive support throughout the recovery journey, fostering an environment of trust, empathy, and evidence-based practice.
team.modelDesc: The heart of our work lies in the belief that comprehensive rehabilitation care starts with a well-rounded team. We bring together physical therapy consultants, rehabilitation specialists, and allied health professionals to ensure every patient receives holistic, evidence-based treatment. This collaborative model allows us to address all facets of recovery—physical, functional, and quality of life—creating a robust foundation for long-term success.
team.seamlessCareDesc: From initial assessment to discharge, we coordinate every step of your rehabilitation journey for a smooth, integrated experience.
team.patientCommunicationDesc: We view the patient as a partner in treatment, keeping you informed and involved in every decision.
team.holisticApproachDesc: We address the whole person—physical, functional, and quality of life—not just the condition.
team.continuousDevelopmentDesc: Our team stays at the forefront of rehabilitation science through ongoing training and the international research network.
team.qualityProfessionalismDesc: We adhere to the highest medical standards and evidence-based protocols in every intervention.
team.collaborativeTeamworkDesc: Specialists work together to design and review your plan, ensuring the best outcome for your case.
team.philosophyDesc1: Our team operates on the principle that recovery is not a solitary endeavor. By combining medical expertise with genuine human connection, we create a therapeutic alliance that empowers patients to take ownership of their healing process. We believe in treating the whole person—not just the addiction—and ensuring that dignity, respect, and hope guide every interaction. Through collaboration, transparency, and ongoing support, we help individuals rediscover their strengths and build sustainable pathways to wellness.

doctorProfile.drMohammedBio:
Dr. Mohamed Ridha Ben Naji Elyazidi is an experienced Physical Therapist specializing in musculoskeletal rehabilitation. With over 10 years of experience, Dr. Elyazidi is dedicated to restoring patient mobility and improving their quality of life through personalized rehabilitation treatments.

Dr. Elyazidi believes in a holistic approach to rehabilitation, focusing not only on treating the physical injury but also on the patient's mental and emotional well-being. He develops individualized treatment plans that address the root cause of each condition, ensuring comprehensive recovery and lasting results.
doctorProfile.drSafaaBio:
Dr. Safaa Mohammed Mahrez is a highly skilled Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Specialist with over 8 years of experience in musculoskeletal rehabilitation. Dr. Mahrez is dedicated to helping patients achieve optimal recovery through individualized care plans that address both physical and emotional well-being.

Dr. Mahrez believes in a comprehensive and patient-centered approach to rehabilitation. By focusing on both injury recovery and overall health, Dr. Mahrez ensures each treatment plan is designed to suit the unique needs and goals of every patient. Her holistic approach combines physical therapy with psychological support to promote healing from within.
doctorProfile.drSirineBio:
Dr. Sirine Al-Habib Al-Qasimi is a dedicated Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Specialist with over 7 years of experience in the field. With a passion for improving patients' physical health, Dr. Al-Qasimi helps individuals recover from injuries and manage chronic conditions to lead a healthier life.

Dr. Al-Qasimi adopts a patient-first approach, ensuring each rehabilitation program is personalized to address the specific needs and goals of the individual. By using evidence-based techniques, she focuses on helping patients regain independence, improve mobility, and enhance overall well-being. Her philosophy is rooted in providing care that nurtures both the body and mind for a holistic recovery.

doctorProfile.drMohammedSpecDesc: As a Physical Therapist & Rehabilitation Specialist, I specialize in helping patients recover from injuries, surgeries, and chronic conditions by restoring mobility, reducing pain, and improving overall functionality. With a focus on individualized treatment plans, I use evidence-based approaches to ensure effective rehabilitation and long-term wellness.

packages.heroDesc: Our therapeutic packages at AL Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center are not "offers"… they are carefully designed rehabilitation plans built on precise evaluation, providing you with an integrated treatment program that suits your condition, needs, and health goals. We do not offer sessions measured in minutes, but rather progressive therapeutic improvement supervised by a specialized team, with the option to integrate home therapy or transportation services when needed and according to your preference.
packages.heroDescSecondary: If you are unsure which package is right for you, you may book an initial consultation session so the team can recommend the most suitable option for your case.
packages.khatwaSessions: For Persons with Disabilities. Fixed 40% discount on the number of sessions determined by the initial evaluation.
packages.alAmalSessions: For Low-income Individuals. Discount of up to 70%, subject to social assessment and supporting documents.
packages.homeTherapySectionTitle: Home Therapy Packages at AL Motahadi
packages.homeTherapySectionDesc: Prefer to continue your rehabilitation in the comfort of your home? Our home therapy packages bring the same level of clinical precision, supervision, and follow-up from the center directly to your doorstep, with flexible scheduling that respects your privacy and daily routine.
packages.intensiveHomeTherapySectionTitle: Intensive Home Therapy Packages at AL Motahadi
packages.intensiveHomeTherapySectionDesc: For cases that require closer follow-up or accelerated progress, our intensive home therapy programs offer structured, high-frequency sessions supervised by our multidisciplinary team, ensuring that every visit moves you one step closer to your goals.
packages.comprehensiveHomeRehabSectionDesc: A fully integrated rehabilitation journey designed for patients who need long-term, continuous care at home. This program combines assessment, treatment, monitoring, and coordination with other medical services to provide a complete, home-based rehabilitation experience.

whoWeAre.teamSubtitle: Meet Our Experts, Your Health Advocates
whoWeAre.teamDesc1: AL Motahadi Center brings together an experienced team of specialists in physical therapy and rehabilitation. We work using a multidisciplinary approach to develop comprehensive, integrated treatment plans for each patient.

homeTherapy.heroDesc: At Al Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center, we believe that recovery should be determined by the quality of care, not by location. We offer home therapy as an extension of the care provided at the center, maintaining the same medical standards, precision, and human commitment.
homeTherapy.heroImageAlt: Healthcare professional assisting a patient in a home setting

It is carefully considered for patients who need privacy, greater comfort, or can't attend in person due to their condition.
homeTherapy.overviewP2: Home therapy begins with a comprehensive medical assessment to develop a personalized treatment plan. The treatment is carried out by qualified specialists using modern therapeutic tools and techniques, bringing the same excellence directly to your doorstep.
homeTherapy.serviceSectionIntro: Home therapy is suitable for patients with various conditions that make in-center visits challenging.
homeTherapy.card1Desc: Patients who face challenges in traveling to the center due to physical limitations.
homeTherapy.card2Desc: Elderly individuals seeking care in the familiar comfort of their own homes.
homeTherapy.card3Desc: Patients recovering from surgery or those requiring careful post-operative follow-up.
homeTherapy.card4Desc: Individuals with chronic conditions requiring sustained and ongoing therapeutic care.

homeTherapy.distinguishP2: We offer flexibility in scheduling, while maintaining a safe, ethical and professional approach to a comprehensive medical care plan. Your home becomes an extension of our rehabilitation facility.

homeTherapy.feature4: Flexible scheduling to suit the patient's circumstances.
homeTherapy.feature5: Strict adherence to professional standards and medical confidentiality.

transportation.importantNoteText: This service does not include medical equipment or intervention during the journey. Our ambulance service is equipped exclusively for safe, supervised patient transportation.

researchNetwork.heroDesc: Our treatment approach is built on a global research network and evidence-based protocols that ensure you receive care aligned with the latest advances in rehabilitation science.
researchNetwork.heroImageAlt: Medical professionals in a research and clinical setting
researchNetwork.foundationIntro: Our vision is rooted in the belief that rehabilitation care should be dynamic, evidence-based, and continuously evolving.
researchNetwork.foundationP1: We have established an international research network that connects rehabilitation professionals across multiple countries. This network does not only share knowledge—it generates it. Through collaborative research, standardized outcome measures, and regular protocol updates, we ensure that every treatment plan at our center reflects the most current scientific understanding.
researchNetwork.foundationP2: Patients benefit from a system that learns and improves over time, with protocols that are reviewed, refined, and validated by a community of experts dedicated to excellence in rehabilitation.
researchNetwork.dynamicDesc: Our research network is not an abstract concept—it is a living system that directly shapes how we assess, treat, and support every patient.
researchNetwork.translateTitle: How Does the Research Network Translate Into Practical Treatment?
researchNetwork.translateIntro: The link between research and daily practice is clear and intentional.
researchNetwork.translate1Desc: Treatment protocols are regularly reviewed and updated based on the latest evidence and outcomes from the network, ensuring your care plan stays current.
researchNetwork.translate2Desc: We draw on aggregated, anonymized data from across the network to inform best practices and identify what works best for conditions like yours.
researchNetwork.translate3Desc: Every intervention is grounded in evidence that has been evaluated and shared by the research community, so you receive proven, effective care.
researchNetwork.translate4Desc: As new findings emerge, the network incorporates them into updated protocols, so the system continuously improves for every patient.
researchNetwork.protocolsIntro: Our protocols are designed to be flexible and responsive—tailored to you, not the other way around.
researchNetwork.protocol1Desc: We begin with a thorough assessment to understand your condition, goals, and context, so your treatment plan is built on a clear foundation.
researchNetwork.protocol2Desc: Goals are set with you and reviewed regularly, ensuring that therapy stays focused on what matters most for your recovery.
researchNetwork.protocol3Desc: Plans are not set in stone. They are reviewed and adjusted as you progress and as new evidence becomes available.
researchNetwork.protocol4Desc: We work in partnership with you, your family, and other healthcare providers to ensure coordinated, consistent care.

blog.post1Body:
Starting rehabilitation soon after injury or surgery can significantly improve recovery speed and long-term results. At AL Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center we focus on early intervention as part of a personalized treatment plan.

Research shows that the first weeks after surgery or injury are critical for restoring function and preventing complications. Our team uses evidence-based protocols to guide you through each phase safely.

Whether you have had joint surgery, a sports injury, or a neurological event, beginning rehabilitation early—under expert supervision—helps you regain mobility, strength, and independence more effectively.
blog.post2Body:
Safe, effective exercises between sessions can support your recovery. Always check with your therapist before starting any new routine.

We often recommend gentle range-of-motion and strengthening exercises that you can do at home, tailored to your condition and stage of recovery. Consistency and correct form matter more than intensity.

Your therapist will show you each exercise and advise on frequency and progressions so you can stay on track between visits.
blog.post3Body:
Understanding typical recovery milestones helps you track progress and stay motivated throughout rehabilitation.

Every person’s journey is different, but there are common phases: from initial healing and pain management to restored movement, strength, and return to daily activities. Our team sets clear goals and reviews them with you regularly.

Celebrating small wins and keeping a long-term view can make a real difference in your outlook and outcomes.
blog.post4Body:
Evidence-based approaches and technology are continually improving outcomes in neurological and organic rehabilitation.

At AL Motahadi we use protocols developed through our international research network, combined with modern equipment and a multidisciplinary team. Treatment is tailored to each patient’s condition and goals.

From assessment to discharge, we focus on measurable progress and quality of life, so you and your family can see the benefits of dedicated neurological rehab.
blog.post5Body:
Staying active safely after an injury protects your recovery and helps you avoid setbacks while maintaining movement and strength.

Our therapists design programs that balance rest and gradual loading, with clear guidance on what to do and what to avoid. We also consider your work, sport, and daily activities so the plan fits your life.

With the right approach, you can keep moving forward without risking reinjury—and return to the activities you care about with confidence.
blog.post6Body:
We are pleased to share the latest updates from AL Motahadi—new services, team highlights, and ways we are improving your care.

Our center continues to invest in training, equipment, and patient experience. We listen to your feedback and adapt our offerings to better serve the community.

Thank you for trusting us with your rehabilitation journey. We look forward to supporting you in the months ahead.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heroDesc: Your privacy is our priority. This policy outlines how Al-Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center collects, uses, and protects your personal information in compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and applicable medical privacy regulations.
privacy.s1Intro: Al-Motahadi Medical Rehabilitation Center is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal and health information in an open and transparent manner. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information in accordance with applicable data protection and medical privacy laws.
privacy.s2Intro: We may collect the following categories of personal data:
privacy.s2Contact: Contact details (name, address, phone number, email)
privacy.s2Medical: Medical history, treatment records, and health-related information
privacy.s2Demographic: Demographic information (date of birth, gender, nationality)
privacy.s2Website: Website usage data and technical information (e.g., IP address, browser type)
privacy.s3Intro: We use your personal information for the following purposes:
privacy.s3Treatments: Managing and delivering treatments and care plans
privacy.s3Communication: Communicating with you about your care and our services
privacy.s3Billing: Billing, insurance claims, and payment processing
privacy.s3Improving: Improving our services and patient experience
privacy.s3Legal: Complying with legal and regulatory obligations
privacy.s3Marketing: With your consent, sending relevant health and service updates (you may opt out at any time)
privacy.s4Intro: We may share your data with third parties only in limited circumstances, including:

privacy.s4Insurance: Insurance companies for claims and authorizations
privacy.s4Legal: Legal or regulatory bodies when required by law
privacy.s4Service: Trusted service providers who assist our operations (under strict confidentiality agreements)
privacy.s4Research: Research purposes only with your explicit consent or in anonymized form
privacy.s5Intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:

privacy.s6Intro: Under applicable privacy laws (including GDPR and HIPAA where relevant), you may have the right to:
privacy.s6Access: Access your personal and health data
privacy.s6Rectification: Request correction or rectification of inaccurate data
privacy.s6Erasure: Request erasure of your data (subject to legal retention requirements)
privacy.s6Withdraw: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
privacy.s7Content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve website functionality, performance, and analytics. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie preference center.
privacy.s8Content: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected and to comply with legal, regulatory, or professional retention requirements. Medical records are typically retained for 7–10 years or as required by applicable law.
